DeployPreview.description: scopeDocuments are the canonical scope documents as opaque audit data; their bundles are outside the contract.

Grant.description: A recorded viewer relationship on a hostname; not an effective-access check, and it may outlive its route.

HeadSummary.description: A checked inventory head and its open execution state; revision identifies the snapshot. It records no installed release version.

InventoryStatusReport.description: Recorded scopes and observed findings are separate; observationComplete false means findings are partial.

PreviewScope.description: configDigest is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the typed configuration only; the tag, image resource, base domain, CDN fields, namespace request and hook effects are in overrides.

Publication.description: An accepted artifact publication. usedBy lists the scopes whose accepted imageResource names it.

ScopeState.description: A recorded scope revision. converged means the accepted revision's execution completed; it is not a live health check.

SiteList.description: Recorded sites from the inventory store only; liveObserved is false because no workload, DNS or certificate was inspected.

SiteSummary.description: A recorded site. state describes scope records, not workload health: converged means the accepted revision's execution completed.

VersionInfo.description: The serving build and the contract versions it emits; not the version a context has installed.

info.description: The read-only admin API of one Nagare context: recorded inventory state, never live workload health. Its components are also Nagare's versioned document contract (docs/api/README.md).
info.title: Nagare admin API
